description: §5.2.3 — the braced fix for the assignment-led sequence, `onclick={ @count = 0; track("reset") }`, compiles clean and runs BOTH statements IN SOURCE ORDER: `track` reads `@count` after the assignment, so `last` records `reset:0` (it would be `reset:5` if the call ran first, and stay "" if the call were dropped).
rationale: §5.2.3: "On each dispatch of the event, the statements of an inline block SHALL run in source order, each one exactly once … No statement of the block SHALL be dropped, whatever its kind or position — in particular, a statement's effect SHALL NOT depend on whether an earlier statement is a call or an assignment". This is the fix E-MULTI-STATEMENT-HANDLER names for `onclick=@count = 0; track("reset")` (see `multi-stmt-handler-assign-led-pos`).
